decision.reason: [ev-707cfb9a39bd] is a single CLI changelog line. It says only that "read-only commands" were added for the `ArtifactGenerator` kind. It does not name the commands or subcommands, so the subject can't be written as a typed assertion. It points to PR #5520 for the details. The change type (added) and the lack of any stated consequence for existing operators are clear enough. To pin down the subject, we need the PR or the CLI docs that list the exact command names.
